label: TP
reason: Alert 1 (java/insecure-randomness) is TP: nextGaussian() generates cryptographically weak random numbers used directly to construct rememberMeKey for session cookies, enabling predictable token generation. Alert 2 (java/xss) is also TP: user-provided cookie values flow into response.getWriter() output via concatenation without proper escaping beyond HtmlUtils.htmlEscape which does not sanitize XSS payloads effectively in this context. Both represent real vulnerabilities.

evidence.note: Random.nextGaussian() feeds insecure memory-based entropy into rememberMeKey for session management
User cookie values concatenated into response output without sufficient protection
